scope: Independent source/specification/result/hash review. The reviewer tested a separate invented counterexample against frozen001; no002 numerical rerun and no real waveform access.
checks: Integer sample indexing selects the nearest template sample, with earlier exact half-sample tie; all native-grid candidate starts within the complete declared plus/minus0.25s support are included without narrowing missing support.

Delay uses actual pick-relative sample offsets and discrete lag. Subtracting the j-minus-i feature delay from the catalog i-minus-j travel-time difference has the tested sign, including biased picks and unequal sample-grid offsets.

The final code independently demeans/scales each candidate and computes its signed Pearson coefficient directly. This removes rolling-moment cancellation without changing the declared mathematical estimator.

Constant template/search candidates, nonfinite/masked records, nonpositive peaks, boundary maxima and numerical ties retain explicit rejection states. All lag coefficients remain available; a constant candidate has an undefined coefficient.

Post-alignment symmetric-Hann/5-bin spectral smoothing uses conj(Xi)*Xj and both power spectra, retains the20 original2-10Hz bins, requires at least10 strictly above0.9, and rejects unresolved powers.

Accepted output stores discrete delay, catalog/result values, coefficient and squared coefficient. The10ms spacing is distinct from formal_timing_uncertainty_s=None; no residual multiplier or solver observation is fabricated.

limitations: These are invented-array component checks, not authoritative waveform decoding, complete native identity joins, a real-data correlation measurement or dt.cc export.
The caller must verify exact NSLC, sample rate/grid/continuity and pick-relative timing, and must supply the catalog i-minus-j travel-time difference with the intended origin-time convention.
